Quick help will be appreciated!

posts.name: Sherin K R
posts.cooked:
It’s from delete_bulk() method in frappe.desk.reportview.delete_bulk. And it is calling from delete_items() in the same file. The delete_items() is a whitelisted method, so that you can override that in your hooks.py and you can change the message as you need.
I hope it should work!
@SherinKR Thanks for your reply but I am directly on Frappe Cloud. So can you please guide me that from frappe cloud how can I change this message?

posts.name: Sherin K R
posts.cooked: I don’t think so, You can’t directly change that from cloud. You need a custom app to override this changes and you can add the same custom app over the frappe cloud.
@SherinKR Thanks for your help brother. After continuous efforts I have solved the issue by writing Client Script directly on Cloud.

posts.cooked: That’s great, Can you share the approach which you have taken. It can be useful for others as-well.

Sure here is my approach by writing client script. Now still I am struggling to find out the solution for the same code to be applied on multiple doctypes. Like we cannot write this same code again and again for each and every doctype needed.

// Client Script for Sales Order List View
frappe.listview_settings['Sales Order'] = {
    onload: function(listview) {
        console.log("[DEBUG] Sales Order ListView loaded");

        // helper: get delete anchors
        function findDeleteAnchors() {
            // menu items in list view
            var anchors = listview.page.page_actions.find(".dropdown-item").filter(function() {
                return ($(this).text() || "").trim() === "Delete";
            });
            console.log("[DEBUG] findDeleteAnchors -> found", anchors.length);
            return anchors;
        }

        // helper: read original click handlers (if any)
        function extractClickHandlers($el) {
            try {
                var el = $el[0];
                var events = ($.fn && $.fn.jquery && ($._data || jQuery._data)) ? ($._data ? $._data(el, 'events') : jQuery._data(el, 'events')) : null;
                if (events && events.click) {
                    // events.click is an array of handler objects ({handler: fn, ...}) in many jQuery versions
                    var handlers = events.click.map(function(h) { return (h && h.handler) ? h.handler : h; });
                    console.log("[DEBUG] extracted", handlers.length, "click handlers");
                    return handlers;
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn("[DEBUG] extractClickHandlers error", e);
            }
            return [];
        }

        // helper: check selected records statuses and call callback(ok:boolean, details)
        function checkSelectedAreAllCancelled(callback) {
            var selected = listview.get_checked_items() || [];
            var names = selected.map(d => d.name);
            console.log("[DEBUG] checkSelectedAreAllCancelled -> selected names:", names);

            if (!names.length) {
                // no selection -> treat as enabled (default)
                callback(true, { reason: "no_selection" });
                return;
            }

            frappe.call({
                method: "frappe.client.get_list",
                args: {
                    doctype: "Sales Order",
                    filters: { name: ["in", names] },
                    fields: ["name", "status"]
                },
                callback: function(r) {
                    try {
                        var rows = r.message || [];
                        var not_cancelled = rows.filter(function(row) { return row.status !== "Cancelled"; });
                        console.log("[DEBUG] server returned statuses:", rows, "not_cancelled:", not_cancelled);
                        callback(not_cancelled.length === 0, { names, rows, not_cancelled });
                    } catch(e) {
                        console.error("[DEBUG] status-check callback error", e);
                        callback(false, { error: e });
                    }
                },
                error: function(err) {
                    console.error("[DEBUG] status-check ajax error", err);
                    callback(false, { error: err });
                }
            });
        }

        // enable/disable visual state (we do NOT use pointer-events:none so our wrapper click still fires)
        function setDeleteEnabled($anchor, enabled) {
            if (enabled) {
                $anchor.removeClass("disabled");
                $anchor.attr("aria-disabled", "false");
                $anchor.data("delete-enabled", true);
                $anchor.prop("title", "");
                console.log("[DEBUG] Delete anchor ENABLED");
            } else {
                $anchor.addClass("disabled");
                $anchor.attr("aria-disabled", "true");
                $anchor.data("delete-enabled", false);
                $anchor.prop("title", "Delete disabled: All selected records must be Cancelled");
                console.log("[DEBUG] Delete anchor DISABLED");
            }
        }

        // safe call of original handlers (or fallback to server deletes)
        function callOriginalHandlersOrFallback($anchor, handlers, event, selectedNames) {
            try {
                if (handlers && handlers.length) {
                    console.log("[DEBUG] Calling", handlers.length, "original handlers");
                    handlers.forEach(function(fn) {
                        try {
                            fn.call($anchor[0], event);
                        } catch(e) {
                            console.warn("[DEBUG] original handler threw", e);
                        }
                    });
                } else {
                    // No original handlers found: fallback to server-side delete per record
                    console.warn("[DEBUG] No original handlers found. Falling back to server delete for each selected record.");
                    if (!selectedNames || !selectedNames.length) {
                        frappe.msgprint("No items selected to delete.");
                        return;
                    }
                    // confirm then delete one-by-one
                    frappe.confirm(
                        __("Are you sure you want to delete these {0} Sales Orders?", [selectedNames.length]),
                        function() {
                            let promises = selectedNames.map(function(name) {
                                return new Promise(function(resolve) {
                                    frappe.call({
                                        method: "frappe.client.delete",
                                        args: { doctype: "Sales Order", name: name },
                                        callback: function(r) { resolve({name, ok: !r.exc}); },
                                        error: function(err) { resolve({name, ok: false, err}); }
                                    });
                                });
                            });
                            Promise.all(promises).then(function(results) {
                                const deleted = results.filter(r => r.ok).map(r => r.name);
                                const failed = results.filter(r => !r.ok).map(r => r.name);
                                if (deleted.length) frappe.show_alert({ message: __("Deleted: ") + deleted.join(", "), indicator: "green" });
                                if (failed.length) frappe.msgprint(__("Failed to delete: {0}", [failed.join(", ")]));
                                listview.refresh();
                            });
                        }
                    );
                }
            } catch(e) {
                console.error("[DEBUG] callOriginalHandlersOrFallback error", e);
                // last resort: allow normal browser behavior (do nothing)
            }
        }

        // main binding routine (rebinds once actions are built)
        listview.page.set_primary_action = (function(original) {
            return function() {
                original.apply(this, arguments);
                console.log("[DEBUG] set_primary_action executed - binding delete wrappers");

                // find anchors and set up hooks
                var $anchors = findDeleteAnchors();
                $anchors.each(function() {
                    var $a = $(this);

                    // store existing handlers
                    var handlers = extractClickHandlers($a); // array of functions

                    // unbind existing click handlers (we will call them manually when allowed)
                    try { $a.off("click"); } catch(e) { console.warn("[DEBUG] off() failed", e); }

                    // attach our wrapper click handler
                    $a.on("click.custom_delete_wrapper", function(e) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                        console.log("[DEBUG] wrapper click fired for Delete");

                        // read data flag (set by selection-change check) - if false, block quickly
                        var enabledFlag = $a.data("delete-enabled");
                        if (enabledFlag === false) {
                            console.log("[DEBUG] Delete visually disabled -> re-check and show message");
                            // do a final server check (safety) and show message if not allowed
                            checkSelectedAreAllCancelled(function(ok, info) {
                                if (ok) {
                                    console.log("[DEBUG] re-check passed -> calling original handlers");
                                    callOriginalHandlersOrFallback($a, handlers, e, (listview.get_checked_items() || []).map(d => d.name));
                                } else {
                                    console.warn("[DEBUG] re-check failed -> blocking delete, showing message", info);
                                    frappe.msgprint("You can only delete Sales Orders if all selected records are Cancelled.");
                                }
                            });
                            return;
                        }

                        // If enabledFlag is true or undefined, still double-check statuses to be safe
                        var selectedNames = (listview.get_checked_items() || []).map(d => d.name);
                        if (!selectedNames.length) {
                            frappe.msgprint("Please select Sales Orders to delete.");
                            return;
                        }

                        checkSelectedAreAllCancelled(function(ok, info) {
                            if (ok) {
                                console.log("[DEBUG] All selected cancelled -> calling original handlers");
                                callOriginalHandlersOrFallback($a, handlers, e, selectedNames);
                            } else {
                                console.warn("[DEBUG] Some selected not cancelled -> blocking delete", info);
                                frappe.msgprint("You can only delete Sales Orders if all selected records are Cancelled.");
                            }
                        });
                    });
                });

                // whenever selection changes, re-evaluate delete enablement
                function bindSelectionWatcher() {
                    try {
                        // listview.$checks is a jQuery list of checkboxes in many versions
                        if (listview.$checks && listview.$checks.length) {
                            // remove previous handler if any
                            listview.$checks.off("change.delete_check");
                            listview.$checks.on("change.delete_check", function() {
                                console.log("[DEBUG] checkbox change detected -> evaluating delete enable state");
                                evaluateAndSetDeleteState();
                            });
                        } else {
                            // fallback: observe clicks in list area (less efficient)
                            listview.wrapper.off("click.delete_check").on("click.delete_check", "input[type=checkbox]", function() {
                                console.log("[DEBUG] fallback checkbox click -> evaluating delete enable state");
                                evaluateAndSetDeleteState();
                            });
                        }
                    } catch(e) {
                        console.warn("[DEBUG] bindSelectionWatcher error", e);
                    }
                }

                // Evaluate: if any selected not cancelled -> disable; else enable
                function evaluateAndSetDeleteState() {
                    var $anchors = findDeleteAnchors();
                    if (!$anchors.length) return;
                    checkSelectedAreAllCancelled(function(ok /*, info */) {
                        $anchors.each(function() { setDeleteEnabled($(this), ok); });
                    });
                }

                // initial bindings & evaluation
                bindSelectionWatcher();
                evaluateAndSetDeleteState();
            };
        })(listview.page.set_primary_action);
    }
};
